## Honest read

### Did the v2 macro overlay improve out-of-sample alpha?
  B vs A score delta: +0.0000 -- effectively zero.
  v2 macro had NO measurable effect on v1 #706's validation result
  because trial #706's high threshold (0.497) sits below v2's score
  floor for ~all rebalance dates in 2024-2026. Same conclusion as
  segment 11's verification step.

### Did v2 #710's optimization translate, or did it overfit?
  v2 #710 train score:       +0.0393
  v2 #710 validation score:  -0.2135
  Drift:                     -0.2528
  Out-of-sample DEGRADATION > 5pp -- v2 #710 overfit to the v2
  training-window distribution. Validation score is the answer.
